core_claims.name: eqSym / eqTrans / eqCong / eqCong2 / applicationCong / transport
core_claims.scope: General propositional equality symmetry, transitivity, one- and two-argument congruence, application congruence from equality of functions, and transport in arbitrary type families.

core_claims.name: evenComm / evenCommRewrite / calculation / leChain
core_claims.scope: Evenness transfers across addition commutativity; substitution and rewrite implementations; an arbitrary-natural equality chain; a transitivity chain for LE.

core_claims.name: Leibniz / leibnizRefl / leibnizTrans / equalityToLeibniz / leibnizToEquality / leibnizSym
core_claims.scope: Leibniz equality as transfer through every admissible type family, with equivalence in both directions to Idris equality and constructive reflexivity, transitivity, symmetry.

deviations: Uses built-in Idris equality so rewrite integrates with the checker.

Idris2 0.8.0 implements Type : Type, as documented in the pinned official FAQ. Agda's predicative universe hierarchy and explicit universe-polymorphic API are not reproduced; checked proof programs remain subject to the host limitation explained in Trust.
Named step/finish/leChain combinators replace the Agda equational-reasoning DSL.
